design: Medium slender adult female Yautja sentinel, muted teal-grey speckled hide, face concealed by a unique narrow bronze angular biomask with a central split ridge and crescent cheek plates. Dreadlocks gathered in long low ponytail. Tailored dark guard tunic with high structured collar, diagonal segmented chest plates, tiny shoulder caps, long thin leather waist streamers and practical reinforced thighs. Holds a slim straight dark ceremonial spear upright in right hand close to body, left hand open at side; neutral measured stance.
